install_app.title: Install NecuTrack
install_app.ios_instructions: In Safari, tap the Share button, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install_app.browser_instructions: Open your browser menu, then choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

recipe.title: Recipes
recipe.description: Combine foods, enter the cooked yield, and get accurate nutrition per 100 g.
recipe.create_description: Ingredient nutrition is added together and divided by the final cooked weight.
recipe.edit_description: Update the ingredients or cooked yield and the nutrition values will be recalculated.
recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.cooked_weight_help: Weigh the complete cooked recipe before saving.
recipe.ingredients_help: Choose each food and enter the total amount used in grams or millilitres.
recipe.type_to_search: Type at least 2 characters to search
recipe.leave_description: Are you sure you want to leave? You can save the recipe before you go.
recipe.no_results_description: Try another recipe or ingredient name.
recipe.saved_description: Saved recipes also appear in Foods and can be logged by weight.
recipe.empty_description: Create your first recipe to calculate its nutrition automatically.
recipe.empty_friends_description: Use a recipe from a friend’s profile to save it here.
recipe.remove_saved_description: This only removes “{{recipe}}” from your saved Friends recipes and from Foods. It does not delete @{{username}}’s original recipe. Existing diary entries stay unchanged, and you can save the recipe again while you remain friends.
recipe.delete_description: “{{recipe}}” will also be removed from your foods. Existing diary entries remain unchanged.
recipe.macro_summary: Protein {{protein}} g · Carbs {{carbs}} g · Fat {{fat}} g · Fibre {{fibre}} g per 100 g
recipe.comment_placeholder: Share a note or suggestion about this recipe
recipe.no_comments: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
recipe.empty_comment_deletes: Saving an empty comment will delete it.
recipe.create_food_help: Choose whether the nutrition values apply to a weight or volume basis. The new food will also be available in your food library.

layout.private_data: A private space for your nutrition data.
layout.promo_quote: Understand your week without turning every meal into a spreadsheet.
layout.promo_copy: Fast food logging, clear macro targets, and reports that tell a useful story.
layout.preview_screen_label: Preview of the daily food diary

landing.head_title: A calmer way to track nutrition
landing.headline: See what you eat. Understand your week.
landing.description: Log meals quickly, keep calories and macros in view, and use simple reports to spot patterns that matter.
landing.feature_log_copy: Search, enter an amount, and get back to your day.
landing.feature_targets_copy: Calories and macros are clear without becoming obsessive.
landing.feature_reports_copy: Daily and weekly views help you understand patterns.

auth.login_description: Sign in to continue your food diary and see how your week is shaping up.
auth.register_description: Create a private account, set your targets, and log your first meal in a few minutes.
auth.reset_description: Enter your email and we’ll send you a secure reset link.
auth.choose_password_description: Use a strong password you haven’t used elsewhere.
auth.two_factor_description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.verify_description: Verify your email address to keep your account secure.
auth.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent.

social.people_description: Find people by username, connect, and share recipes with friends.
social.username_not_found: No user exists with the username @{{username}}.
social.no_received_requests: You have no received friend requests.
social.no_sent_requests: You have no sent friend requests.
social.no_requests_description: Requests you send and receive will appear here.
social.no_friends_description: Search for a username to send your first friend request.
social.remove_friend_warning: You will lose access to this person's recipes and will no longer be able to use them. To become friends again, you will need to send a new friend request.
social.recipes_private_description: Become friends to see and use this person's recipes.
social.no_shared_recipes: This user has no recipes yet.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Friend requests and social updates for your account.
notifications.empty_description: New friend requests and acceptances will appear here.

onboarding.title: Make the diary yours
onboarding.description: Start with targets you already use. You can change everything later in your profile.
onboarding.hint: Macro and fibre values are optional in foods, but targets help make your weekly reports more useful.

diary.title: Food diary
diary.ai_day_date_help: Detected foods will be added to this date.
diary.ai_day_input_help: Add optional notes and up to 10 photos covering everything eaten during the day.
diary.ai_day_description_placeholder: For example: photos 1–2 breakfast at 08:00; lunch was 250 g chicken with rice; the final photo is an afternoon snack
diary.ai_day_paste_images: Meal names, ingredients, brands, and approximate amounts in grams are very helpful. You can also paste images here with Ctrl+V or Cmd+V.
diary.ai_day_images_help: Add photos in chronological order when possible. Large images are compressed automatically before upload.
diary.ai_day_too_many_images: You can add a maximum of 10 images.
diary.ai_day_privacy: Your notes and images are sent to the configured AI provider. Images are not saved by NecuTrack, and nothing is added to the diary until you review and confirm the detected foods.
diary.ai_day_estimate_error: We couldn't analyze this day. Add more detail or try again.
diary.ai_day_review_help: Check every food, meal, weight, and per-100-g nutrition value. Remove incorrect entries before saving.
diary.ai_day_review_waiting: Detected foods will appear here after the AI analysis.
diary.ai_day_no_entries: No foods remain to add. Retry the estimate or return to the diary.
diary.ai_day_save_error: We couldn't add these foods. Check the values and try again.
diary.ai_food_placeholder: For example, 2 scrambled eggs, 2 slices of toast with butter, and a small latte
diary.ai_paste_images: Ingredients and approximate amounts in grams are very helpful for an accurate estimate. You can also paste an image here with Ctrl+V or Cmd+V.
diary.ai_images_help: Add up to 2 images of the meal, packaging, or nutrition label. Large photos are optimized automatically.
diary.ai_image_processing_error: We couldn't process that image. Try another photo.
diary.ai_too_many_images: You can add a maximum of 2 images.
diary.ai_input_required: Describe the food or add at least one image.
diary.ai_privacy: Your description and images are sent to the configured AI provider to estimate nutrition. Images are not saved by NecuTrack, and no diary entry is created until you review and add it.
diary.ai_food_details_waiting: These fields will be completed by AI after the estimate.
diary.ai_review_help: AI estimates can be inaccurate. Edit the weight and per-100-g values before adding the food.
diary.ai_meal_review_help: The meal is split into separate foods when they can be estimated reliably. Check each item and remove anything incorrect before saving.
diary.ai_meal_no_entries: No foods remain to add. Retry the estimate or return to the diary.
diary.ai_meal_save_error: We couldn't add these foods. Check the values and try again.
diary.ai_estimate_error: We couldn't estimate that meal. Add more detail or try again.
diary.quick_entry_description: Log the total calories directly. Add macros and fibre if you know them; otherwise they will be saved as zero.
diary.entry_name_help: Leave empty to use “Quick calorie entry”.
diary.optional_macros_help: Enter totals for the complete entry, not values per 100 g.
diary.quantity_help: How many times this amount was consumed.
diary.note_placeholder: Energy, appetite, training, or anything useful…

food.logging_description: Choose a food or recipe, then enter the unit, amount, and quantity.
food.library_description: Browse recent foods, favourites, and recipes. Press Search to search the full database.
food.scan_barcode_help: Hold the barcode horizontally inside the frame. Keep it steady and move slightly closer if needed.
food.camera_preview: Live camera preview for barcode scanning
food.camera_permission_error: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
food.camera_unavailable: No suitable camera is available on this device.
food.camera_unsupported: Camera scanning is not supported by this browser.
food.camera_error: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it and try again.
food.no_results_copy: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or add it as a custom food.
food.local_no_results_copy: No match in this list. Press Search to search the full database.
food.barcode_not_found_copy: Add its name and nutrition information. The barcode will be saved automatically.
food.add_product_details_copy: Enter the name and nutrition information shown on the package.
food.empty_library_copy: Add a custom food to start building your personal library.
food.empty_favourites_copy: Search for a food and tap the heart to keep it here.
food.empty_recent_copy: Foods and recipes you log will appear here. Quick calorie entries are excluded.
food.empty_recipes_copy: Your recipes and other people’s recipes you favourite will appear here.
food.macro_summary: Protein {{protein}} g · Carbs {{carbs}} g · Fat {{fat}} g · Fibre {{fibre}} g
food.shared_product_help: This product will be available to everyone.

weight.title: Weight tracking
weight.description: Log your weight and follow the direction of your progress.
weight.change_context: From the first to the latest entry
weight.form_description: Add one measurement for each day.
weight.note_placeholder: Optional context, such as time of day
weight.trend_description: Your measurements from the selected period.
weight.delete_description: The {{weight}} kg measurement from {{date}} will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
weight.empty: Log your first weight to start seeing your trend.

reports.title: Weekly report
reports.description: Trends and averages from your food diary.
reports.empty_patterns: Log a few meals to see your patterns.
reports.weight_trend_description: Measurements from the 12 weeks ending with this report.
reports.empty_weight: Log your weight to see its trend in reports.

settings.title: Profile
settings.session_copy: Sign out on this device. Your diary data remains safely stored in your account.
settings.delete_copy: Permanently removes your profile, diary, custom foods, targets, and reports. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete_confirm: Delete your account and all nutrition data permanently?
